4 افظع as intrans.: see 1, first sentence. ＝
-A2- أَفْظَعَنِى الأَمْرُ The affair, or event, made me to fear, or frightened me: made me to fall into a hard, difficult, or distressing, case: (TA:) made me to be without power, or strength, or ability; disabled, or incapacitated, me. (Ham p. 32.) ―
-b2- And أُفْظِعَ He (a man, S, O, Msb) suffered the befalling of a hard, difficult, or distressing, event. (S, O, Msb, K.) ―
-b3- See also 10.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
